summary: TWT Phase 3 full test pass (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/phase3_test.py (41 tests: hotels CRUD/validation/role-gating, expenses CRUD/filter/defaults, exchange-rates owner-only upsert/validations/delete, summary conversion matrix incl. unidirectional rate check, trip cascade). Result: 40/41 pass — the ONLY backend failure is the suspected cascade gap: DELETE /api/trips/{trip_id} does NOT delete hotels/expenses/exchange_rates. Regression Phase 1+2 (backend_test.py 23 + phase2_test.py 81) = 104/104 pass; full suite 144 passed / 1 failed. Migration /app/backend/scripts/normalize_orders.py re-run is idempotent (stops modified=0, attractions modified=0). Frontend: seeded trip TEST_UI_P3 (trip_8a85bb217d11403f), dev-login alice — spend total, missing-rates amber badge + popover + CTA, rates dialog (both entry points), hotel add/edit/delete, expenses add, and attraction drag&drop regression (persisted) all work. ONE frontend integration bug: after saving/deleting a rate in ExchangeRatesDialog the sub-header total and missing-rates badge are NOT refreshed (stale until another mutation or page reload).

critical.issue: Cascade is incomplete: hotels, expenses and exchange_rates survive trip deletion (verified in Mongo: {'stops':0,'attractions':0,'trip_members':0,'hotels':1,'expenses':1,'exchange_rates':1}). Orphan data grows and can leak into a re-created trip_id namespace. trips.delete_trip must also delete_many on db.hotels, db.expenses, db.exchange_rates.

minor.issue: Upsert is read-then-write (find_one + update/insert) while a unique index exists on (trip_id,from,to); two concurrent PUTs for the same pair can raise DuplicateKeyError -> 500. Use update_one(..., upsert=True) with $setOnInsert rate_id.
No way to request only general (stop_id=null) expenses: ?stop_id= (empty) matches literal '' and returns []. Consider ?stop_id=none / ?general=true semantics.
Unbounded to_list(500/2000/5000) caps are silent truncation risks for large trips (same note as iteration_6).

integration_issues.issue: After saving USD->EUR=0.9 in the rates dialog, the rate row appears in the dialog, but the sub-header 'Spend total' stays at the stale value (€460.00) and the amber 'X excluded' badge remains visible even after the dialog closes. Correct value (€478 / badge gone) only appears after an unrelated mutation (hotel/expense) or a page reload. Root cause: ExchangeRatesDialog has no onSaved/onChanged callback and Trip.jsx never calls refreshSummary() on rate mutation or when ratesOpen closes. Same applies to rate deletion.

issues: TripTotals is `hidden md:flex`, so on mobile (<768px) the user has no access to Spend total nor to the missing-rates warning — the only remaining rates entry point is the small coin icon. Consider a compact mobile variant.
useDndReorder registers only PointerSensor — no KeyboardSensor, so reordering is impossible without a pointer (a11y gap).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): trips.delete_trip must cascade db.hotels, db.expenses, db.exchange_rates (test already written: phase3_test.py::TestTripCascadePhase3::test_delete_trip_cascades_all_six_collections).

FIX (HIGH): refresh the trip summary after rate create/update/delete — add an onSaved/onChanged prop to ExchangeRatesDialog (or call refreshSummary() when ratesOpen turns false) so trip-spend-total and missing-rates-btn update immediately.
Optional: make the rate upsert atomic (update_one upsert=True + $setOnInsert) to avoid DuplicateKeyError 500 under concurrency.
Optional: expose Spend total / missing-rates on mobile; add KeyboardSensor for DnD a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: hotels.py PATCH correctly revalidates the EFFECTIVE (check_in, check_out) range and returns 422 without mutating — verified; HotelUpdate itself has no cross-field validator, so this route-level check is the only guard (keep it if other write paths are added).

summary.py convert() is strictly unidirectional (only looks up (item_currency, home_currency)) — verified no implicit inversion; missing items are excluded from the total and reported with affected item ids.

summary.py attractions query filters cost {$ne: null, $gt: 0}: attractions with cost 0 are skipped entirely (harmless) but a null-currency legacy attraction falls back to home_currency, which silently counts it as home money — acceptable for now, worth a data note.
Trip.jsx is 564 lines and already close to the split threshold; the rates/summary wiring gap above is a symptom of the growing state surface — consider a useTripData hook.

rca_of_the_issue: (1) Cascade: trips.delete_trip was written in Phase 1 and only deletes attractions/stops/trip_members; Phase 3 collections were never added, so hotels/expenses/exchange_rates remain keyed to a deleted trip_id. (2) Totals staleness: Trip.jsx calls refreshSummary() after every stop/attraction/hotel/expense mutation, but ExchangeRatesDialog owns its rate mutations locally (api.put/api.delete + local load()) and exposes no change callback; Trip.jsx also does not refresh on ratesOpen -> false, so the summary state keeps the pre-rate value until any other mutation triggers refreshSummary().
